name: 芬奇
description: 成年，约三十五岁；身高约180厘米；男性中音，轻滑狡黠，英式英语口音。

attributes.movement: 动作机敏，熟练操控船索，并以灵活的刀剑技巧进行近身战斗。

variants.appearance: 体格壮实的成年男性水手，穿磨旧的空盗船员服装并携带刀剑。
variants.stage1_prompt:
Adult male sky-pirate sailor, about 35 years old and 180 cm tall, scrawny and wiry, with narrow shoulders, long limbs, bony hands, a sharp nose, hollow cheeks, restless eyes, and a sly appraising half-smile. Uneven black mullet with short hacked sides and a long feathered nape.

He wears a cream collarless sailor shirt beneath a fitted striped waistcoat, a cropped burgundy deck jacket with contrasting lining, a narrow scarf, crossed leather braces, and a patched sash. Slim dark-green trousers, mismatched buttoned gaiters, and narrow reinforced deck boots. Layered construction remains agile rather than bulky. A brass-and-steel knife-deployment bracer wraps one forearm, with visible hinges, spring housing, and locking lever. A compact geared belt reel, articulated shoulder brace, varied buckles, small tool pouches, concealed knife sheaths, and a short cutlass complete the outfit.

Full-body, slightly hunched sideways stance with one hand hovering near a concealed blade. Simplified wooden skyship deck with masts and brass fittings, subordinate to the character.

Complete flat-color 2D production character concept, six-and-a-half-head proportions, crisp varied-width ink linework, opaque flat colors, clear graphic shapes, minimal texture, no lighting, shading, gradients, or painterly rendering.
